mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.7% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in prior month, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 110, the manufacturing sector faces capacity constraints that lead to higher input costs and reduced profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% over the past month signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 202.0 in the prior month signals accelerating inflation that erodes real consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 202.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.05.
